Which of the following statements best describes the influence of anthropogenic greenhouse gases on the climate compared to natural greenhouse gases?

questions.question: Anthropogenic greenhouse gases, such as CO2 and methane, occur in higher concentrations and cause an intensified warming of the Earth's atmosphere beyond natural fluctuations. This leads to significant changes in the global climate and has far-reaching effects on ecosystems and weather phenomena.

C: The influence of anthropogenic greenhouse gases on the climate is negligible and cannot be compared to natural variations.

Which of the following statements best describes the mechanism of immunotherapy in treating cancer?

Immunotherapy activates or enhances the body's natural defense mechanisms to attack cancer cells. This is often done through the use of substances that stimulate the immune system or help it recognize the cancer cells. The other options do not accurately describe the mechanism or applications of immunotherapy.

questions.question: A: Immunotherapy is solely limited to the use of monoclonal antibodies.
choices: C: Immunotherapy requires surgical removal of tumors in all cases before treatment.
D: Immunotherapy harnesses the body's own immune system to selectively recognize and destroy cancer cells.
C: Immuntherapie erfordert in allen Fällen eine chirurgische Entfernung von Tumoren vor der Behandlung.
D: Immuntherapie nutzt das eigene Immunsystem des Körpers, um Krebszellen gezielt zu erkennen und zu zerstören.
questions.explanation: B: Immunotherapy is a form of chemotherapy that aims to inhibit cell division.
